title: 3 money leaks
items: Room up to Rs 7,500 a night: 5% GST. Above it: 18%. Discounts come off before tax. Let the bill do the maths.
Send every table and room order straight to a kitchen screen: New, Preparing, Ready.
Deduct ingredients by recipe as dishes sell, log waste with a name, and get an alert before you run out.
Export sales, purchase and GST registers to Excel for your CA. No month-end panic.
footer: Rizstay runs front desk, kitchen and billing on one screen, in the browser. No installs.
